thread:
maya: CI red on snapshot compare after my tiny serializer tweak. failing case: chatbot_14 (prompt render). looks like escaped quotes + an extra leading space in one line.
eng-ci-bot: Build #12345 — tests failed — snapshot diff available https://ci.redwood/12345/artifacts/snapdiff.txt
sam: @maya can you paste the minimal failing snippet? :eyes:
maya: here's the core of the diff i see:
```
- "Bot: \"Hello\""
+  "Bot: \"Hello\""  # note extra leading space on the new line
```
liam: that spacing change screams accidental formatting change from the serializer in PR #452. might be a pretty small regression.
olivia: i can repro locally, trying a quick rerun with the same seed.
maya: local repro steps i used:
```bash
# reproduce the exact job locally
./tools/run_snapshot --case chatbot_14 --env PYTHONHASHSEED=0
# or quick smoke
./ci local --case chatbot_14
```
sam: you can also trigger the same CI job with `./ci rerun 12345` to get the identical environment.
olivia: rerun queued, i'm watching the logs. same diff appears. :frowning_face:
liam: request bisect — can someone run bisect between origin/main~10 and origin/main? this looks like a behavioral change.
maya: i started a manual bisect locally to narrow it down a bit:
```bash
git bisect start origin/main origin/main~10
git bisect run ./tools/run_snapshot --case chatbot_14 --quiet || true
```
marked a couple commits as good/bad, but i don't have cycles to finish tonight. passing to @olivia if you can continue.
olivia: i'll take the bisect tomorrow morning. leaving notes: suspected culprit is the tiny json escaping helper in serialization.py that changed how we add leading whitespace when concatenating segments.
maya: temporary mitigation: i added `SERIALIZER_LEGACY_QUOTES=1` as a CI env in the pipeline to restore previous behavior while we fix the root cause. queued a new build.
sam: alternative would be to add a tolerant golden-compare flag, but env pin is fastest unblock.
eng-ci-bot: Build #12346 queued (with SERIALIZER_LEGACY_QUOTES=1).
eng-ci-bot: Build #12346 — SUCCESS — snapshot diffs cleared for chatbot_14.
olivia: opening follow-up issue to add unit tests for quoting/leading-space cases and to track removing the temporary env pin.
maya: thanks everyone, i'll follow up on the PR to revert the micro-change and add a test. :thumbsup:
sam: great, ping when the bisect lands or if you want me to take it over.
liam: leaving a comment on the issue with the likely patch.
maya: resolving for now, will update the issue with bisect findings tomorrow.
